run_prompt_optimization: run prompt optimization with gpt-3.5-turbo optimizer and text-bison scorer on gsm8k dataset
test_scorer_and_optimizer_servers: test the scorer and optimizer LLM servers with a simple yes/no question
configure_scorer_model: configure the text-bison scorer model with temperature and max decode steps settings
configure_optimizer_model: configure the gpt-3.5-turbo optimizer model with temperature and batch size settings
load_and_split_dataset: load gsm8k or bbh dataset and split into train and evaluation sets
